item.buckets_update.bucket.water_only: Denne bøtta kan bare inneholde vann
advancements.buckets_update.root.title: Bucketry
advancements.buckets_update.root.descrip: Velkommen til ditt første bøtteeventyr. Velg din vei: tre, bambus, kobber eller jern.
advancements.buckets_update.splash.title: Plask
advancements.buckets_update.splash.descr: Fyll en bøtte med vann — tre, bambus eller kobber.
advancements.buckets_update.old_school.d: Lag en jernbøtte — med den reviderte oppskriften.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_wooden: Lag en trebøtte: 5 planker i en V. Lett, men knekker etter ~16 bruk.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_copper: Lag en kobberbøtte: 5 kobberbarrer i en V. Middels holdbarhet — varer lenger enn tre, knekker til slutt.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_bamboo: Lag en bambusbøtte: 5 bambusplanker i en V. Dobbelt så hardfør som tre — ~32 bruk.
advancements.buckets_update.udder_master: Melk en ku i en tre-, bambus- eller kobberbøtte.
advancements.buckets_update.last_drop.de: Drikk opp en melkebøtte — tre, bambus eller kobber.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_gold.d: Craft a gold bucket: 5 gold ingots in a V. Carries water, lava, milk, and powder snow — 32 uses.
enchantment.buckets_update.fluid_infinit: Places liquids using experience points instead of emptying the bucket.
enchantment.buckets_update.thermal_shiel: Grants passive Fire Resistance when holding a lava bucket.
Chance to place liquids without consuming them.
